response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The database contains at least 10 distinct observstation values in telescopes; otherwise no query can return exactly 10 observatories.
